findings.detail: Earlier question M3-S12-T1 has the same problem: a batch where some requests fail because they exceed the context limit. The same reasoning reaches the same answer there: resubmit only the failed items, identified by custom_id, after chunking them. This question splits that answer into options A and B and moves it from contracts to source files, but the problem does not change. More than one wrong option also repeats. Option E (keep resubmitting the full batch) matches the earlier 'resubmit the full set' option. Option D (resubmit the failed files unchanged) matches the earlier 'resubmit failed unchanged' option. Option C (a tool that fetches content during processing) repeats a wrong option from M1-S46-T1.

blind_answer.reason: Following 4.5-S3, the retry step should use custom_id to resubmit only the 30 failed requests (B), and chunk the oversized files so they fit within the context limit (A). C won't work because batches don't support multi-turn tool calling. D resends the files unchanged, so they hit the same context limit regardless of the processing window. E still pays for the full batch and never fixes the cause of the failures.
